title: Aromatic Roasted Kenyan Meat Stew
description: A hearty keto-friendly stew featuring roasted meat and red pepper paste, simmered to perfection in one pot. This dish is a classic Kenyan recipe with a rich and aromatic flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef or goat meat and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the red pepper paste, beef broth, tomato paste, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
